scope: One 24-task stratified Terminal-Bench 0.2.18 development set: 8 historical tasks (H) plus 16 new tasks (N) across 10 category buckets. Single fresh attempt per method; no cross-task memory.
methods: official Pi plus official Spine plugin
official Sentry core plus controlled terminal host
exclusion_rules: media/vision task requiring large offline weights
multi-service compose (host runs the client container alone)

grading.legacy: offline fixed-wheel protocol from round3: paused snapshot, docker commit, unchanged original tests, cached uv + pinned wheels, no network
grading.new: generic protocol: paused snapshot, docker commit, unchanged original tests, then the task's own run-tests.sh with network; this is a documented deviation from the legacy offline path and must be reported per task

cross_task_experience: reset for every task; execution evaluation only
feedback: task instruction, initial environment and ordinary tool results only; hidden tests injected after stopping
host_differences: Pi and controlled terminal host are different; results compare complete integrations rather than isolated component effects
purpose: stratified development set; not a benchmark leaderboard or generalization result
